dirk.title: A Seat Fit for an MVP
dirk.subtitle: A global ambassador partnership with Dirk Nowitzki for Lufthansa Allegris to answer one simple question: how can a 7ft MVP basketball player sleep comfortably on a plane?
dirk.story_title: A simple idea with real fit.
dirk.story_p1: Starting in 2024, we partnered with NBA legend Dirk Nowitzki as Lufthansa's official brand ambassador to promote the new Lufthansa Allegris. One of the additions was a seat with an extra-long bed that measures 7 ft 2 in, enough for a 7-foot MVP with room to spare.
dirk.story_p2:
What began as a cold call from Dirk's team turned into an ongoing partnership with one of the most iconic German athletes of all time. Dirk's creative has since been featured in campaigns across the world, from San Francisco and Chicago to Munich and Tokyo.

As one of the most famous German athletes of all time, Dirk Nowitzki has become the face of Lufthansa Allegris the past 3 years across marketing campaigns and in-person appearances.

work.hero_intro: Brand storytelling across creator programs, global partnerships, and multi-channel campaigns.
work.dirk_desc: A global ambassador story for Lufthansa Allegris built around one idea: size deserves scale.
work.creator_desc: A creator ecosystem built around fit, trust, and measurable performance.
work.patriots_desc: An ongoing three-year partnership with the 6-time Super Bowl champions, hosting events and fan moments in Germany and bringing Boston fans closer to the story across Frankfurt, Berlin, and Munich.
work.disney_desc: Selected entertainment partnership work connecting Lufthansa with Disney storytelling, audiences, and cultural moments.
work.film_desc: Visual effects, branded documentaries, festival shorts, and film production work that shaped the storytelling instinct behind the marketing.
